summary: One non-blue color forms four disconnected three-cell L corners for each rectangular frame. Blue cells enclosed by a frame are reflected left-right when every seed column lies on one horizontal side of the frame center; otherwise the demonstrated top-only or bottom-only seed is reflected up-down. Blue cells outside all frames are distractors and are removed.
